card.name: Adjectives before study or risk nouns
card.fires_on: Modifier words such as greater, recommended, pooled and technical that sit right before a noun like risk, duration, analysis, report or assistance, mostly in label or report prose.

modes.label: Pooled/greater modifiers
modes.description: Words like pooled or greater placed before analyses, trials or risk.
modes.example: In a retrospective analysis of<< pooled>> clinical trials with immediate-release nevirap

modes.label: Technical/recommended
modes.description: Adjectives like technical or recommended before report, assistance or duration.
modes.example: The<< recommended>> duration of treatment for pediatric patients with genotype
